prompt:
Challenge C088-CH2: Membranes in dairy plants foul quickly and need cleaning every week.
Detail: At two dairy plants we service — one near Temerin, one outside

content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Membrane fouling in protein-rich bioprocess streams can be characterised using resistance-in-series frameworks and atomic force microscopy to identify foulant deposit composition and structure.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03384","field":"abstract","quote":"the resistance-in-series framework as a diagnostic and modelling tool"},{"id":"R0269","field":"bio","quote":"atomic force microscope for foulant surface characterisation"}]},{"text":"Enzymatic pre-treatment with proteases can reduce membrane fouling during ultrafiltration of protein-rich streams by partial hydrolysis, increasing limiting flux and reducing fouling resistance by up to 47 percent.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"Controlled proteolytic pre-treatment can serve as a feasible upstream option for bioreactor clarification steps"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03380","field":"abstract","quote":"the total fouling resistance measured at 2 bar TMP was reduced by 47%"}]},{"text":"Transmembrane pressure control strategies using feedback mechanisms that reduce TMP when flux decline exceeds thresholds can extend membrane service intervals and reduce irreversible fouling resistance by 31 percent.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-03379","field":"abstract","quote":"irreversible fouling resistance was 31% lower under Strategy 3 compared with Strategy 1"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-03379","field":"abstract","quote":"feedback TMP reduction triggered when the flux decline rate exceeded 5% per 10 min"}]}],"fit":"strong","fitReason":"The researcher has published extensively on fouling mechanisms in dairy whey ultrafiltration, CIP chemistry, and TMP control strategies [SYN-PUB-03384, SYN-PUB-03379] and has direct experience with enzymatic pre-treatment for fouling mitigation [SYN-PUB-03380] and contract research with dairy processing companies on CIP optimisation [R0269], directly addressing the challenge's core problem of rapid membrane fouling in dairy MBR systems."}
